Tidewell opens a second office in Rotterdam

ROTTERDAM (4 May 2022) — Tidewell Software today opened its second office, which will employ 25 people by the end of the year.

The company said its annual recurring revenue passed $4 million in the first quarter of 2022.

Tidewell's flagship product now monitors more than 12,000 kilometres of drainage pipe for its customers.

The new office will be led by Joris van Dam, who joined from a Dutch engineering consultancy in January.

We are delighted to bring our world-class platform closer to the customers who rely on it every day.

Tidewell was founded in 2016 and is based in Austin, Texas.
